records.public_safe_text: unit 1 was traveling northwest on us 82. a pedestrian was walking on the north shoulder of us 82, then failed to yield the right of way to unit 1 [roadway] of travel. the pedestrian was struck by unit 1's front right, fatally injuring the pedestrian. after the crash, unit 1 traveled across the center stripe divider and stopped upright on the south improved shoulder of us 82 facing northwest. the pedestrian came to rest on the center stripe of us 82, facing southwest on his back. witnesses on the scene advised that the pedestrian had been drinking prior to walking into the roadway. they stated that the pedestrian was mad that his keys to his vehicle had been taken from him so that he would not leave, therefore he decided to attempt to walk home. the pedestrian was transported to the dallas medical examiner's office for autopsy. the medical examiner's office will conduct a toxicology report to reveal possible intoxicating substances in the pedestrian. it was raining during the time of the crash. there are photographs of this crash available. supplement [date] to indicate crash investigation complete after adding toxicology results.
